name: Diff 评审
description: 代码评审：右栏导航列出相对评审基线（merge-base 语义，含未提交与未跟踪改动）的全部变更文件，主区渲染统一 diff（旧/新行号、可折叠空隙、二进制占位），支持行级评论并在提交时把整篇评审作为草稿放进聊天输入框（不自动发送）。
descriptionEn: Code review: a right-panel navigator lists every file changed relative to the review base (merge-base semantics, uncommitted and untracked changes folded in), the main area renders a unified diff (old/new line numbers, foldable gaps, binary placeholder), and line-anchored comments assemble into a review draft placed in the chat input on submit (never auto-sent).
